findings.evidence: The nonzero proof uses only positivity of `Measure.haar`; the two invariance proofs use Haar-map instances and `Measure.isHaarMeasure_eq_of_isProbabilityMeasure`, whose Mathlib signature at `Measure/Haar/Unique.lean:700` requires `[LocallyCompactSpace G]`, not `[CompactSpace G]`.
findings.fix: Move these three generic results to a section with `[LocallyCompactSpace G]`; keep the `haarProb` definition and its specialized instances in the compact-group section.
findings.issue: `haar_univ_ne_zero`, `isMulRightInvariant_of_isHaarMeasure_of_isProbabilityMeasure` (line 84), and `isInvInvariant_of_isHaarMeasure_of_isProbabilityMeasure` (line 99) inherit `[CompactSpace G]` without using compactness beyond obtaining `LocallyCompactSpace G`.

summary: Three declarations unnecessarily require compactness although their proofs only need local compactness; the generic Haar API should be separated from the compact normalization section.
